name: Pieter Van Der Merwe
bio:
Pieter's motorsport journey began unexpectedly. After completing his degree in aeronautical engineering at the University of Pretoria, he initially pursued a career in commercial aviation. However, a chance encounter with a local karting team needing aerodynamic advice sparked a passion that quickly consumed him. He was fascinated by the challenge of optimizing performance through subtle adjustments to airflow.

Pieter joined Sodi Kart Factory fifteen years ago and quickly rose through the ranks. His approach to aerodynamics is holistic, viewing the kart as a complete system. He emphasizes data-driven analysis, using wind tunnel testing and computational fluid dynamics to identify areas for improvement. He also values collaboration, believing that the best solutions arise from open communication between engineers and drivers. Pieter's distinctive ability lies in his knack for translating complex technical concepts into practical, actionable advice for the track.

His leadership style is defined by his commitment to innovation and his ability to inspire his team to push the boundaries of what's possible. He encourages experimentation and risk-taking, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the aerodynamics department.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave on the left side.
physical.description: Pieter is a man of solid build, with a thoughtful gaze and an air of quiet intensity.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking Rooibos tea during meetings.
